{{Quote|If you're in the mood for fish, this seafood slider features a grilled firaxan shark fillet in place of the standard patty, topped with Ahto City cheese, chewy Selkathian seaweed and relish squiggles.|Dex's Diner menu, on the Manaan slider|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Relish''' squiggles were an [[Foodstuff/Legends|ingredient]] in the [[Manaan slider]] offered at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[slider]] was created by the diner's [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] and inspired<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> by the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Kotor">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Relish was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
